name: YMCA Camp Sloper
description_short: A large YMCA day camp in Southington for kindergarten through 9th grade, run in two week sessions with themes. Days include swim instruction and free swim, unit games and rotating activities, with specialty camps for older campers and a preschool program called Wanderers.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Home page: says the 2027 brochure comes out in December 2026 and 2027 registration opens February 6.
Researched by Claude from this page. Day camp home page states YMCA Camp Sloper is ACA accredited; traditional camps run K to 9th grade (see dates and rates).

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 dates and rates. Prices are non-member Traditional Camp (K to 9th) rates: $635 per two week session, $365 for Preview Week and Finale Week; members pay $585 and $340. Specialty camps $655 non-member, Farm and Golf camps $715 and $725. Before care from 7 or 8 am and after care to 4, 5 or 6 pm for an added fee. Financial assistance for Southington and Cheshire residents only. Wanderers (Pre-K) is $310 a week non-member.
Researched by Claude from this page. Contact page: 1000 East Street, Southington, CT 06489.
